title: ROI Selector
text: Select a region of interest (ROI) from pixel stream, 3 inputs, 2 outputs; {Reuse output ports for vertically aligned regions} sets the option to return one pixel stream for each column, {Regions source} sets the location of output region definitions, {Regions} sets the rectangular ROIs to select from input frame R -by-4 and {Number of regions} sets the number of region input ports integer in the range. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: pixel
ports.summary: Input pixel stream scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: ctrl
ports.summary: Control signals associated with pixel stream pixelcontrol bus

ports.name: region1,...,regionR
ports.summary: Region of interest four-element row vector

ports.name: pixel1,...,pixelR
ports.summary: Output pixel stream scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Reuse output ports for vertically aligned regions
params.values: Option to return one pixel stream for each column of regions off (default) | on

params.name: Regions source
params.values: Location of output region definitions Property (default) | Input port

params.name: Regions
params.values: Rectangular ROIs to select from input frame R -by-4 matrix

params.values: Number of region input ports integer in the range [1, 16]
